hypotheses.R1_rank64_behavior_is_sampling_stable: Across all twelve cells, base versus higher-sample rank-64 fidelity has Spearman correlation at least 0.95 and maximum absolute difference at most 0.05.
hypotheses.R2_rank128_behavior_is_sampling_stable: Across all twelve cells, base versus higher-sample rank-128 fidelity has Spearman correlation at least 0.90 and maximum absolute difference at most 0.10.
hypotheses.R3_more_samples_stabilize_literal_axes: Higher sampling raises median leading-64 sketch overlap by at least 0.10 at every boundary.
hypotheses.R4_behavior_is_more_stable_than_coordina: Rank-64 fidelity correlation is at least 0.30 higher than mean literal basis overlap.
hypotheses.R5_highsample_chart_still_beats_static: Higher-sample rank-64 fidelity exceeds static rank-64 fidelity by at least 0.20 in every cell.
